name: ChatGPT · Comfortable Reading Width
description: Gives ChatGPT one centered, adjustable reading column. ChatGPT caps every conversation turn and the composer at --thread-content-max-width (768px); this raises that cap so the whole thread and the input box share one wider, centered column. Default width matches ChatGPT's native width; the slider goes much wider for big screens.
author: Nagi Studio
